A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OmniThink work. All 21 pages, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–L, support reliable comparison through text extraction and visual inspection.

before.justification: v3 reports original WildSeek evaluations in Tables 2–3, ablation experiments, human evaluations in Appendix C, and additional empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental results, including WildSeek evaluations, ablations, human ratings, and knowledge-density validation.

M1.justification: The information tree, conceptual pool, iterative expansion and reflection, outline construction, and article composition procedures are unchanged, including the appendix prompts and algorithms.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same WildSeek coverage of 100 topics across 24 domains and retain the same synthetic factual-article evaluation and AGI case studies. No datasets or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain the same comparator membership, including RAG, oRAG, STORM, and modified Co-STORM where applicable. The oRAG-Plus comparison in Section 5.2/Figure 5 is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The four backbone configurations, generation settings, automatic evaluation procedures, article-length trimming, and 20-topic human evaluation design remain unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices A–C.

E4.justification: Both retain identical component ablations, expansion/reflection and depth analyses, boundary comparisons, URL and runtime analyses, knowledge-density validation, and AGI case studies.

E5.justification: Appendix B.3 and Table 4 report the same variances from three evaluation runs using saved checkpoints. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains GPT-4o OmniThink's knowledge density of 22.31 and novelty score of 4.31; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The task formulation, information-tree and conceptual-pool update equations (1)–(2), and knowledge-density definition (3) are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about iterative thinking, knowledge density, preserved article quality, and model-agnostic applicability.

C2.justification: Interpretations of information and cognition boundaries, diminishing returns with depth, and human-versus-automatic evaluation differences are unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning multimodal information and personalized writing styles.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, retrieval and scoring details, prompts, and pseudocode are unchanged. The homepage, demo, code, and supporting resource links retain their targets.

R1.justification: The cited works, Section 6 related-work discussion, and positioning relative to STORM, Co-STORM, and other prior approaches are unchanged.

P1.justification: The acknowledgements add 'Zhejiang University' after the institutional credit, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 is rendered smaller in v5, with corresponding shifts in Table 3, Figure 4, and surrounding text. Spacing and column breaks change on pages 6–9, while table structures and figure contents remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 preserves the scientific content, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations, including all appendices. The acknowledgement clarification and modest layout adjustments do not establish a meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
